claims.text: Times like 7:30 am, 7am, 13:05 and noon are read correctly, with 12 am as midnight and 12 pm as noon.
The things on a person's day are listed in time order, and items with the same time stay in the order typed.
An item whose time is not clear is never guessed. It is listed under Time not clear.
At most 5 things on the day and 5 reminders are used, and the page says when some are left out.
Weather and news content is made up, always marked Example, and never claims to be today's weather or news.
The saved plain text holds only the parts the person ticked, in a fixed order, with the date in plain words.
When weather or news is ticked, the briefing says live weather and news are not on this page yet.
Messy typing never crashes, never shows NaN or undefined, and bad entries get plain words.
A bad date or no parts picked gets a calm message in plain words.
